title: Explicit reset of an agent draft to a versioned base preset
outcome: Implement the observable behavior in tasks/VF-016.md while preserving real installation data.
acceptance: Read and satisfy the complete English specification in tasks/VF-016.md; its boundaries and negative criteria are mandatory.
AC-1 / Read the built-in preset repeatedly and after restart / Stable ID/version and identical normalized payload; no user/agent mutations / Unit and disposable PostgreSQL/API tests

AC-2 / Customize and save an agent, then confirm reset with its current revision / Draft exactly equals the selected preset; revision increases once; name/ID stay; one truthful audit event / API integration and browser test

AC-3 / Cancel confirmation, use viewer/anonymous access, omit CSRF, use foreign origin, stale revision, unknown ID/version, or invalid preset / No draft/binding/history mutation; existing auth/error conventions apply; stale revision is 409 / Negative API/browser tests
AC-4 / Race reset against a save/publish using the same revision / Only the serialized valid mutation wins; stale competitor is rejected; no lost update / PostgreSQL concurrency test

AC-5 / Reset while an agent has a published/active version and a synthetic active session / Published JSON bytes, binding/version IDs and session pin remain unchanged; no room cleanup or provider request / Transactional integration assertions with explicit synthetic gateway

AC-6 / Restart API/web/worker after reset, then explicitly publish and activate / Draft survives restart; activation affects only future sessions; existing session remains pinned; prior version remains exportable and bindable / Disposable restart integration/browser flow

AC-7 / Compare seeded data before/after reset / Same users/password hashes, sessions/events/diagnostics, saved views and historical versions; only intended draft/revision/audit changes; environment secret sentinels unchanged / Disposable database/state comparison; no credential values in report

AC-8 / Remove an optional customization file or omit it at startup / No implicit reset, deletion, reseeding, binding change, or account change / Restart regression; document that explicit reset is required

Use only synthetic disposable data. No home SSH, real .env, provider calls, paid fallback, merge, deployment or automatic owner acceptance. Delegate only bounded subtasks when useful; no two writers in one checkout.
